problem:
The random variable $X$ has the following probability distribution.

| $x$ | $-2$ | $-1$ | $0$ | $1$ |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| ${f}_{X}(x)$ | $0.1$ | $0.2$ | $0.3$ | $0.4$ |

Let $Y=\frac{{X}^{4}}{4}.$ The distribution of $Y$ is given below.

| $y$ | $0$ | $a$ | $b$ |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| ${f}_{Y}(y)$ | $0.3$ | $c$ | $0.1$ |

What is the value of $b+c?$
